**q22.** Dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (→ `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, `:47`), called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`. Delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`/`:120`; 4 queue-consumer goroutines at `:42-56`). Signing: HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body` with the per-webhook signing secret, base64-encoded into Standard-Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,<sig>` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:133-150`.

**q25.** Engine: CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine at `internal/filter/` — `engine.go:24` (`NewEngine`), `engine.go:48` (`Compile`), field schema `schema.go`, IR `ir.go`, SQL rendering `render.go`. Mechanism: the CEL expression is parsed into a dialect-neutral condition tree, then `renderer.Render` (`internal/filter/render.go:32`) emits SQL fragments + bound args using per-dialect column expressions keyed by `DialectName` (`schema.go:11-16`, e.g. `internal/filter/schema.go:104-107`); each driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectSQLite|DialectMySQL|DialectPostgres, &where, &args)` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (the memo itself plus its comment memos deleted at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577`); `memo_share` is removed only by the DB-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK (`store/migration/*/LATEST.sql:102-108`) — note SQLite opens with `foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade does not fire on SQLite. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545-550`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web` bundle is compiled into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by an Echo static handler with SPA fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:41` (`FrontendService.Serve`), `:63` (`spaFallbackMiddleware`), `:115` (`getFileSystem`); registered from `server/server.go:72`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — started at server/server.go:162-171: RunOnce(ctx) immediately, then Run(ctx)
                   loops on a 12h time.Ticker (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by package init(), driven by the
                   bounded channel asyncPostQueue, not by a schedule (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-56)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (cron-style job scheduler with parser/middleware) is referenced only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `integration_test.go:13`) — the server never starts it. Also `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` / `NewRunner` / `RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) is never invoked by the server; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:152-176` (attached to the transport at `:186-190`; the SSE/token state lives in `web/src/auth-state.ts`). Tokens managed: a short-lived JWT **access token** (localStorage, `memos_access_token`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`, refreshed proactively/on 401 via `AuthService.RefreshToken`) and the HttpOnly **refresh token cookie** (`memos_refresh`, sent via `credentials: "include"`, `web/src/connect.ts:57-61`). Backend validation: `server/auth` (`Authenticator` in `server/auth/authenticator.go`, token parsing/constants in `server/auth/token.go` — access token V2, refresh token, and `memos_pat_` Personal Access Tokens), invoked by the Connect `AuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213-231`) and `Authorizer` (`server/router/api/v1/authz.go`).

**q30.**
```
memo created:          DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook          — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called memo_service.go:157)
memo updated:          DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook          — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo deleted:          DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook          — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created:  DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook   — memo_service_webhooks.go:29 (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three converge on `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120` for HTTP delivery.
